title: Hypnia?
description: An ancient settlement of Lokris, attested in Thucydides and some epigraphic evidence. It is generally identified (though unproven) with a fortified enclosure located on a hill now known as Gardiki near modern Tritaia (formerly Kolopetinitsa).

properties.description: Representative location based on OpenStreetMap. Chronology following the Barrington Atlas.
